# Accounts Payable Tax Review Policy

## Tax Payment Rule

Accounts Payable may pay invoiced sales tax when the vendor is registered to collect tax and no valid exemption certificate is on file for the purchasing entity.

If an exemption certificate is missing, AP should not remove tax based only on an email assertion.

## Review Escalation

Tax charges above $1,000 require tax-team review before final payment.

The review note must cite the invoice, vendor tax profile, and exemption certificate status.
